objective: Make practice articles useful to prospective learners with visible direct links and genuine current exercise screenshots
acceptance: Each depicted trainer has an adjacent descriptive direct exercise link
Screenshots show actual current anonymous practice UI without learner data
Article links are visibly identifiable without hover and have keyboard focus
Images and captions are useful and readable on narrow screens
counterexamples: An invisible link is not an adequate reader path
A decorative cover is not a product screenshot
A working HTTP route alone does not prove that the reader reaches the described exercise
No screenshot can imply a real learner result or automatic score guarantee
